calls.title: Tanner / Ashley / Emmy
calls.summary: The team agreed on a streamlined social media posting process to enhance coordination and visibility. Over-communication via a dedicated Slack channel will keep all team members informed about social media tasks, with Tanner responsible for posting updates. Posting responsibilities were clarified, with Tanner managing LinkedIn, Emmy handling blogs, and Ashley overseeing Facebook and Twitter. They decided to use Buffer for scheduling and tagging to optimize multi-platform posting. Additionally, they reinforced a strict guest approval process with a seven-day turnaround and discussed technical needs for embedding episodes on the website. The team confirmed the importance of branding assets and established a schedule for newsletters and daily reels to maintain consistent audience engagement.
calls.keywords: social media posting, podcast episodes, reels, LinkedIn newsletter, content approval, Buffer scheduling, branding, CMS fields
calls.action_items:
**Tanner Green**
Ensure all episode approval emails include Ashley, Emmy, and Tanner in cc for transparency and coordination (02:33)
Be over-communicative on Slack regarding social media post statuses and content readiness to keep the team informed (03:42)
Handle posting of episode live announcements, newsletters, LinkedIn newsletters, reels, and social media posts for Facebook and Twitter (04:32)
Remove shorts from the podcast playlist on YouTube to maintain channel organization (08:30)
Schedule reels on Buffer for YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, and select posts for LinkedIn with accompanying text posts (11:34)
Include company branding consistently in all posts by always mentioning the guest’s company name for recognition and engagement (12:38)
Provide two example CMS field outputs for episodes by end-of-day for team review and feedback to streamline data entry (19:40)
Continue sending episode drafts to guests within a 7-day turnaround window for approval before publication (17:48)
Share requested horizontal logo image of Experimentation Edge with the team for use in posts and branding (18:53)

**Emmy Sharp**
Write blog posts for every podcast episode on the GrowthBook website to support content marketing efforts (13:29)
Coordinate with Karen on embedding podcast episodes and UTM tracking integration on the website for better analytics (16:38)
Communicate with Tanner and Ashley regarding posting schedules and cross-posting responsibilities to ensure alignment (06:28)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Provide Tanner access to LinkedIn tracking app for analytics sharing to monitor post performance effectively (11:16)
Coordinate crossposting guidelines with Tanner and Emmy, clarifying which platforms and posts to share for consistency (06:08)
Continue managing guest communication regarding episode approval timelines to maintain smooth publishing workflow (20:25)
